proof_explanation: The repair corrects the negate function to return !value instead of false. This implements total Boolean negation: for all boolean inputs, the function returns the logical negation of that input. The postcondition ensures result == !value is now satisfied for all cases: negate(true) returns false and negate(false) returns true.
